prompt:
A Binary Search Tree (BST) is constructed by sequentially inserting the following keys into an initially empty tree:
`[175, 125, 225, 100, 150, 200, 250]`

What is the exact **Postorder** traversal sequence of this tree?
explanation: Postorder traversal visits Left Subtree -> Right Subtree -> Root. Root 175 is processed last after all its children: [100, 150, 125, 200, 250, 225, 175].
